name: WholeStack WF-026: Criterion Evidence Adapter Orchestrator

parameters.jsCode: const b=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const criteria=[...new Set((Array.isArray(b.criteria)?b.criteria:[]).map(x=>String(x).trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))]; const sources=Array.isArray(b.sources)?b.sources:[]; const jobs=[]; const taxCriteria=criteria.filter(c=>c==='tax_delinquent'); const courtCriteria=criteria.filter(c=>['probate','pre_foreclosure'].includes(c)); const genericCriteria=criteria.filter(c=>['fixer_upper','distressed'].includes(c)); if(taxCriteria.length) jobs.push({adapter:'tax',url:$env.N8N_INTERNAL_BASE_URL+'/webhook/wholestack-official-tax-evidence-v1',criteria:taxCriteria,sources:sources.filter(s=>['county_tax','tax_delinquency','county_property'].includes(String(s.type||s.source_type||'').toLowerCase()))}); if(courtCriteria.length) jobs.push({adapter:'court',url:$env.N8N_INTERNAL_BASE_URL+'/webhook/wholestack-official-court-evidence-v1',criteria:courtCriteria,sources:sources.filter(s=>['court_probate','probate_record','estate_record','foreclosure','court_record','land_record'].includes(String(s.type||s.source_type||'').toLowerCase()))}); if(genericCriteria.length) jobs.push({adapter:'generic',url:$env.N8N_INTERNAL_BASE_URL+'/webhook/wholestack-criterion-evidence-adapter-v1',criteria:genericCriteria,sources}); return [{json:{request_id:String(b.request_id||('criterion-orch-'+Date.now())),state:b.state||null,county:b.county||null,city:b.city||null,zip:b.zip||null,property_address:b.property_address||null,parcel_id:b.parcel_id||null,owner_name:b.owner_name||null,limit:Math.min(100,Math.max(1,Number(b.limit||25))),jobs,criteria}}];

const input=$input.all(); const results=input.map(i=>i.json); const records=results.flatMap(r=>Array.isArray(r.criterion_results)?r.criterion_results.flatMap(x=>Array.isArray(x.records)?x.records:[]):[]); const limitations=results.flatMap(r=>Array.isArray(r.criterion_results)?r.criterion_results.flatMap(x=>x.limitations||[]):[]); return [{json:{success:true,request_id:$('Prepare Adapter Jobs').first().json.request_id,criteria:$('Prepare Adapter Jobs').first().json.criteria,adapter_results:results,records,record_count:records.length,limitations:[...new Set(limitations)],policy:'Specialized official tax and court adapters are preferred for their criteria; generic evidence routing remains available for fixer_upper/distressed. Signals are evidence candidates, not automatic seller outreach triggers.'}}];
